claimMap.scopeAndFreshness: Dated vendor release and API availability.

sourceEvidence.excerpt: September 10, 2026: OpenAI says it is launching GPT-Live-1 in the API for developers building voice-enabled apps and business workflows.
OpenAI describes GPT-Live-1 as capable of listening and speaking at the same time, with deeper reasoning and actions delegated to models and tools paired with it.

Traditional voice agents stitch together speech-to-text, a reasoning model, and text-to-speech. Each handoff adds latency and creates more opportunities to lose timing, context, or the natural rhythm of a conversation.
OpenAI lists telephony support for phone calls from restaurant reservations to customer support.
OpenAI says GPT-Live-1 is available in the API at $0.05 per minute for the front-end voice layer; the backend model and agent harness remain separate parts of the product.
OpenAI presents smoother interruption handling, background-noise handling and longer-session reliability as product strengths and reports its own evaluations and customer statements.

candidateEvidence.excerpt: Yelp said it had integrated the voice model into Yelp Host

claimMap.scopeAndFreshness: Attributed adoption claim from the adopting company.

sourceEvidence.excerpt: Yelp announced that it integrated GPT-Live-1 into Yelp Host, its voice AI solution for restaurants, and Hatch, its communications platform for service businesses.
Yelp describes GPT-Live-1 as the front-end voice layer that interacts directly with callers while Yelp Host and Hatch supply business data and operational intelligence.
The company says callers can interrupt, change topics mid-sentence or speak to people in the background while the voice system adapts.
Yelp says initial production testing showed improved call handling and fewer call transfers, but the release provides no sample size, method, geographic rollout or independent evaluation.
Yelp says this is reflected in more Yelp Host callers speaking in full, natural sentences during early testing, rather than short voice commands.

The release says Yelp Host has handled more than one million calls since launching in October 2025. That is product history spanning the period before this September 2026 integration announcement, not a GPT-Live-1 performance count.

sourceEvidence.excerpt: September 10, 2026: OpenAI says it is launching GPT-Live-1 in the API for developers building voice-enabled apps and business workflows.
OpenAI describes GPT-Live-1 as capable of listening and speaking at the same time, with deeper reasoning and actions delegated to models and tools paired with it.

Traditional voice agents stitch together speech-to-text, a reasoning model, and text-to-speech. Each handoff adds latency and creates more opportunities to lose timing, context, or the natural rhythm of a conversation.
OpenAI lists telephony support for phone calls from restaurant reservations to customer support.
OpenAI says GPT-Live-1 is available in the API at $0.05 per minute for the front-end voice layer; the backend model and agent harness remain separate parts of the product.
OpenAI presents smoother interruption handling, background-noise handling and longer-session reliability as product strengths and reports its own evaluations and customer statements.
GPT-Live handles a spoken conversation while a backend agent looks up information, uses tools, and completes tasks. It can listen while speaking, a capability called full duplex.
GPT-Live handles conversation; the backend handles delegated tasks, including reasoning, tools and business rules.
The application owns permissions, confirmations, private function execution and durable task state. Interrupting speech does not automatically cancel backend work.
GPT-Live voice sessions are billed by duration, while backend model and tool usage is billed separately.
